<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most intense ion at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.045 Da. The formula that best fits this mass is C₈H₈O (exact mass = 120.0575 Da). The IR spectrum shows a carbonyl stretch around 1737 cm⁻¹ and aromatic C–H stretches (≈3100 cm⁻¹), consistent with an aromatic aldehyde. Phenylacetaldehyde (C₆H₅‑CH₂‑CHO) matches both the formula C₈H₈O and the observed functional‑group absorptions. Its SMILES representation is **O=CCc1ccccc1**. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the proposed structure.</thought>
<final_answer>O=CCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
